serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Let’s call Big Daddy.
You: Hello Big Daddy! Did you see what’s happening outside?! 
Big Daddy: Yeah, I’m kinda busy right now, little one, I have no time to talk with you, even through the phone.
You: Did something happen?
Big Daddy: Yeah, you could say that. 
You: Are you alright or-
Big Daddy: Listen, I gotta go *pow*, I gotta go now!
What was that about?
Something big had to happen if Big Daddy was that distressed.
I should ask him later about it, after all this madness is over…
